metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Essex County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Llewellyn Park Historic Enclave, St. Cloud & Pleasant Valley, Gregory & South Mountain Section, Downtown & Valley Arts District
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 4.21%, with an equalization ratio of 69.4%.
Public education represents 56.4% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 27.2%.
Average residential assessment is $388,640, producing an average annual tax bill of $16,361.74.

neighborhoods.name: Llewellyn Park Historic Enclave
neighborhoods.character: America's first gated romantic suburban community (est. 1857), home of Thomas Edison's Glenmont estate, with historic custom mansions on acreage
neighborhoods.description: Historic landmark gated community founded by Llewellyn Haskell, featuring gas lamps, private gatehouse security, and lush wooded arboretum grounds.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Ultra-high assessment bracket where estate taxes reach $35,000–$65,000 annually.

neighborhoods.name: St. Cloud & Pleasant Valley
neighborhoods.character: Elevated residential section atop the Watchung Mountains with modern custom colonials, ranches, and South Mountain Reservation borders
neighborhoods.description: Scenic hilltop neighborhood offering sweeping NYC skyline vistas from Eagle Rock Reservation, proximity to Turtle Back Zoo, and top-rated elementary schools.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Homeowner base heavily reliant on school district performance to sustain property values.

neighborhoods.name: Gregory & South Mountain Section
neighborhoods.character: Charming suburban residential streets bordering South Orange, featuring pre-war brick colonials, Tudors, and quiet sidewalks
neighborhoods.description: Popular family neighborhood with jitney bus service to South Orange NJ Transit station for rapid midtown direct train commuting into NYC.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: High effective tax rate (~3.34%) creates pressure for property tax relief and shared municipal services.

neighborhoods.name: Downtown & Valley Arts District
neighborhoods.character: Historic urban core near Edison National Historical Park, featuring renovated loft apartments, two-family homes, and arts venues
neighborhoods.description: Historic birthplace of the modern recording and motion picture industries at Thomas Edison's laboratory, transitioning into an arts district.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Contains commercial redevelopment zones and municipal library/public works facilities.

equityAnalysis.summary: West Orange Township maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In West Orange Township, homeowners pay an average of $16,361.74 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 13.48% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 69.4%, assessed values average ~69.4% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 56.4% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 27.2%, and Essex County claims 16.4%.
